status_note: The current paper is scoped to relation-candidate ranking for a fixed entity pair. The four-dataset matrix is NELL23K, FB15K237-2, WN18RR, and CoDEx-M. CoDEx-M data and full 10-way eval questions are converted; Stage1/Stage2 task inference and model runs remain pending. Its entity-corruption verified negatives are separate from relation candidates. CLEGR graph-level QA is out of scope.

excluded_datasets.reason: Graph-level QA has typed answer spaces and requires graph-edit counterfactuals; SC-CL is defined over relation candidates for a fixed entity pair.

fixed_protocol.current_search_scope: 2026-10-30 user instruction: NELL23K, FB15K237-2 and CoDEx-M, single seed 2026, fixed Stage-1 adapters, Stage-2 hyperparameters only; full-test improvement is required. Multi-seed work is deferred for this phase.
